test_cases.input: My 4-month-old was feeding and suddenly stopped breathing. Her lips are turning blue and she isn't making any sound.
test_cases.rationale: Complete airway obstruction with cyanosis in an infant is immediately life-threatening.

test_cases.input: He ate a peanut snack and now his face and lips are swelling up and he's struggling to breathe.
test_cases.rationale: Facial/lip swelling plus breathing difficulty after allergen exposure suggests anaphylaxis.

test_cases.input: My daughter has been shaking all over for more than 6 minutes and she is not responding to me.
test_cases.rationale: Seizure lasting more than 5 minutes with unresponsiveness is a life-threatening emergency.

test_cases.input: He has a high fever and is acting very confused. He does not recognize me and keeps staring blankly.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with confusion or altered mental status is a red flag for serious CNS infection or sepsis.

test_cases.input: My baby is very floppy and I cannot wake him up properly. He only makes a weak sound when I shake him.
test_cases.rationale: A floppy, difficult-to-wake infant may have severe illness or impaired consciousness.

test_cases.input: I think my toddler swallowed a small round button battery from a toy about 20 minutes ago.
test_cases.rationale: Button battery ingestion can cause rapid caustic injury and requires emergency management.

test_cases.input: She has a fever and a purple rash on her legs that does not fade when I press a glass on it.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with non-blanching rash is a red flag for meningococcal sepsis.

test_cases.input: He slipped under the pool water for a short time. I pulled him out, but now he keeps coughing and seems very tired.
test_cases.rationale: Submersion episode with persistent cough and lethargy can indicate aspiration or respiratory compromise.

test_cases.input: My 6-week-old baby has a temperature of 38.2 degrees Celsius. She is feeding less than usual.
test_cases.rationale: Fever in infants under 3 months requires urgent medical evaluation.

test_cases.input: My 18-month-old has vomiting and diarrhea. He has not had a wet diaper for about 10 hours and has no tears when crying.
test_cases.rationale: No urine for 8+ hours with gastroenteritis symptoms suggests significant dehydration.

test_cases.input: She fell from the sofa and hit her head. Since then she has vomited three times and seems unusually sleepy.
test_cases.rationale: Head injury with repeated vomiting and abnormal drowsiness is an emergency red flag.

test_cases.input: He has a bad cough and I can see the skin pulling in between his ribs every time he breathes.
test_cases.rationale: Chest wall retractions indicate increased work of breathing and need urgent assessment.

test_cases.input: My 9-year-old has worsening pain on the lower right side of his belly and he is walking bent over.
test_cases.rationale: Worsening localized right lower abdominal pain can suggest appendicitis or another surgical abdomen.

test_cases.input: My teenage son suddenly has severe pain in one testicle and feels sick to his stomach.
test_cases.rationale: Sudden severe testicular pain is concerning for torsion and needs emergency evaluation.

test_cases.input: Hot soup spilled on her hand and wrist. The skin is blistering and she is crying in a lot of pain.
test_cases.rationale: Blistering burn involving the hand/wrist is potentially significant and requires urgent assessment.

test_cases.input: He cut his finger on glass. I have pressed firmly with a towel for 25 minutes but it is still bleeding heavily.
test_cases.rationale: Bleeding that continues despite 20+ minutes of firm pressure requires urgent care.

test_cases.input: A dog bit my child's calf and there are two deep puncture wounds with bleeding.
test_cases.rationale: Deep animal bite wounds require urgent cleaning, infection risk assessment, and possible prophylaxis.

test_cases.input: My son has a fever and his knee is hot and swollen. He refuses to stand or walk on that leg.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with hot swollen joint and refusal to walk is concerning for septic arthritis.

test_cases.input: I found my 3-year-old with an open bottle of my blood pressure tablets. I think some pills are missing.
test_cases.rationale: Possible ingestion of adult medication can be dangerous even before symptoms appear.

test_cases.input: She has a barking cough and now makes a harsh noisy sound when breathing even while sitting quietly.
test_cases.rationale: Stridor at rest suggests significant upper airway narrowing and needs urgent care.

test_cases.input: My 4-year-old has a fever of 40.1 degrees but is drinking water, talking to me, and peeing normally.
test_cases.rationale: High fever without red flags in an older child usually needs same-day clinical advice rather than emergency care.

test_cases.input: My toddler woke up crying and pulling at her right ear. She has a cold and her temperature is 38.0.
test_cases.rationale: Ear pain with fever after a cold suggests possible ear infection needing timely assessment.

test_cases.input: My daughter says it burns when she pees and she has a fever today.
test_cases.rationale: Dysuria with fever suggests possible UTI requiring same-day evaluation.

test_cases.input: He has vomited five times since this morning but is still alert and had a wet diaper two hours ago.
test_cases.rationale: Persistent vomiting warrants urgent advice, but recent urination and alertness reduce immediate dehydration concern.

test_cases.input: My child is wheezing a little with a cold, but he can talk normally and is not pulling in his ribs.
test_cases.rationale: Wheeze needs medical review, but absence of distress suggests urgent rather than emergency level.

test_cases.input: She has a sore throat, fever, and swollen glands in her neck, but she can swallow drinks.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with sore throat and swollen glands may require same-day or next-day clinical assessment.

test_cases.input: He twisted his ankle at the playground yesterday. Today he is limping, but there is no obvious deformity.
test_cases.rationale: Persistent limp after injury may need assessment for sprain or fracture.

test_cases.input: My son says his eye hurts and bright light bothers him after he scratched it with a toy.
test_cases.rationale: Eye pain with photophobia after trauma may indicate corneal injury needing timely review.

test_cases.input: My 3-year-old has a fever and a red spotty rash, but the spots fade when I press on them and she is drinking.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with blanching rash may still need assessment but lacks immediate meningococcal red flag.

test_cases.input: My 5-year-old has not pooped for four days and cries when trying to go, but his belly is soft.
test_cases.rationale: Constipation with pain may need clinical guidance, but soft abdomen and no severe symptoms reduce emergency concern.

test_cases.input: She touched a hot mug for a second. There is a small red patch on her fingertip but no blister.
test_cases.rationale: Small superficial burn without blistering or sensitive-area involvement is usually non-emergency but may need advice.

test_cases.input: He put a small soft piece of tissue up his nose. I can see it, he is breathing fine and is completely calm.
test_cases.rationale: Visible nasal foreign body with normal breathing and calm child needs clinic removal, not emergency resuscitation.

test_cases.input: She got a small paper cut on her finger. It bled a little but stopped after a few minutes.
test_cases.rationale: Minor cut with bleeding controlled is low urgency.

test_cases.input: He has a small patch of itchy hives on his tummy after trying a new soap, but he is breathing normally.
test_cases.rationale: Localized hives without breathing difficulty, swelling, or systemic symptoms is not anaphylaxis.

test_cases.input: My baby has a red rash in the diaper area today. She is feeding normally and has no fever.
test_cases.rationale: Diaper rash without fever or systemic illness is low acuity.

test_cases.input: Her left eye is a bit red and had some sticky yellow discharge this morning, but she is otherwise well.
test_cases.rationale: Mild eye redness/discharge without pain, swelling, or vision changes is usually semi-urgent.

test_cases.input: He tripped on the carpet and bumped his forehead. He cried right away but now is playing normally and has not vomited.
test_cases.rationale: Minor head bump with normal behavior and no vomiting or drowsiness is low acuity.

test_cases.input: He threw up once this morning and had one loose stool, but he is drinking and has been peeing normally.
test_cases.rationale: Mild GI symptoms with normal hydration are generally low urgency.

test_cases.input: She has a runny nose and mild cough, no fever, and she is eating and playing normally.
test_cases.rationale: Mild cold symptoms without fever, respiratory distress, or poor intake are low acuity.

test_cases.input: My child has a tiny wooden splinter in his finger. The skin is a little red but there is no pus or fever.
test_cases.rationale: Small splinter without infection or systemic symptoms is low urgency.

test_cases.input: He had a nosebleed for about five minutes after picking his nose, but it has completely stopped now.
test_cases.rationale: Brief nosebleed that stops quickly is low urgency.

test_cases.input: She has a mosquito bite on her arm that is itchy and a little swollen, but she feels fine.
test_cases.rationale: Localized itchy insect bite without systemic allergic features is low acuity.

test_cases.input: I just want to know when I can start giving my 6-month-old baby small amounts of solid food.
test_cases.rationale: Routine feeding guidance without illness or injury is non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My 2-week-old gets hiccups after feeds but is breathing normally and feeding well.
test_cases.rationale: Hiccups after feeding in a well newborn are usually benign and non-urgent.

test_cases.input: He has yellowish flaky skin on his scalp but no fever and it does not seem to bother him.
test_cases.rationale: Cradle cap without infection signs is non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My newborn has tiny red bumps with white centers on her face, but she is feeding well and has no fever.
test_cases.rationale: Well newborn with benign-appearing rash and no fever is non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My 2-year-old only wants to eat pasta and bread this week, but he is active and drinking normally.
test_cases.rationale: Picky eating with normal activity and hydration is non-urgent.

test_cases.input: She is 4 months old and suddenly started waking more often at night, but she is feeding well and has no fever.
test_cases.rationale: Sleep changes in an otherwise well infant are routine/non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My toddler has not pooped for two days, but he is eating, playing, and his belly is soft.
test_cases.rationale: Short constipation without pain, vomiting, distension, or illness is non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My baby is drooling a lot and chewing on everything. She has no fever and is still feeding normally.
test_cases.rationale: Teething symptoms without fever or feeding problems are non-urgent.
